notes.title: V1.01.16 Feature Update
notes.notes:
New Features
Added resolution and fullscreen options in settings

notes.title: Demo Balance Update
notes.notes:
balance：
To allow players to experience the joy of different weapon branches, we have reduced the experience points required for leveling up between levels 1 and 12. This will enable you to explore various weapon options more quickly and to experience the unique charm of different weapons in the early stages of the game.
